scientific_integrity.claims_supported_by: exact killed-OU image kernel, Gaussian-window series and small-time Gaussian increment expansion
scientific_integrity.numerical_support: 56 independent symbolic/numerical assertions; not substituted for analytic proof
scientific_integrity.proof_scope: all fixed kappa,D,a>0 and independent Poisson reset rate r>0

scientific_limitations: The result is for a reset-free excursion conditioned on both nonabsorption and absence of the next Poisson reset; it does not describe the unconditional repeatedly-reset process.
An interior strict local minimum is guaranteed when 0<w<3, without uniqueness; global monotonicity for w>=3 is not established.
Asymptotic error terms are pointwise in positive fixed w, and publication priority is subject to possible unindexed equivalent findings.
title: Hermite-node reversal in survival-conditioned Ornstein–Uhlenbeck residence
